title: Tidepool integration - upload errors
symptom: The Tidepool integration can fail with the error "400 Bad Request", leading to "stuck" uploads. Users report seeing 'Found Existing Remote Dataset' followed by 'Data Upload was not Sucessful: 400 Bad Request.'
cause: The thread identifies that invalid values in xDrip, such as negative CGM values, are not accepted by Tidepool servers, causing the 400 response. A specific case with a negative calculated_value is mentioned.
fix: A fix was created in pull request #983, which adds a data validation step before uploading to Tidepool. The fix is to be implemented in ESensorGlucose.
evidence_quote: This occurs when there are invalid values in xDrip that the Tidepool servers will not accept, resulting in the 400 response (such as negative CGM values).
